notes:
# Orvio 0.43

- Film and series pages show the IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes scores under the title.
- Scores are now also found for titles your provider lists under a translated or original name (for example "Hausu" or "La casa de papel").
- With more than one playlist, Play and Resume ask which version to watch: each shows its quality (4K, 1080p, 720p, HDR), language and provider. Qualities are remembered, so the list fills in at once next time.
- Series pages let you pick which playlist the episodes come from, so another provider can stand in when one is down.
- Live TV shows one playlist at a time; pick the playlist at the top of the channel list.
- Faster start with two playlists: Home opens on your main playlist straight away and the other joins a moment later.
- Films and series watched from your second playlist now appear in "Recently watched".
- Home no longer flashes empty after a background playlist update.
